name: cafoo
description: Cafoo: the agentic finance ERP. Agents propose, an Advisor rules, the CFO confirms, every number drills down.

scripts.demo:fresh: cd spacetimedb && spacetime publish ${SPACETIMEDB_DB_NAME:-cafoo} --server local --delete-data=always --yes && cd .. && pnpm -F @cafoo/seed generate && pnpm -F @cafoo/seed load
scripts.demo:close: cd apps/agents && CLOSE_NO_WAIT=1 DEMO_STEP_MS=0 node --import tsx src/cli-close.ts
scripts.gen:bindings: cd spacetimedb && spacetime generate --lang typescript --out-dir ../packages/stdb-bindings/src --module-path ./spacetimedb --yes && spacetime generate --lang typescript --out-dir ../apps/web/src/lib/module_bindings --module-path ./spacetimedb --yes
scripts.publish:local: cd spacetimedb && spacetime publish cafoo --server local --yes
